title: Positions of a mapped term code
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term of width at most $w$, and let $S$ be a set of positions in the list of literals of $T$. Map these positions into the first $w$ coordinates using their natural coordinate embedding, and construct a switching block code with that mapped position set and any bit assignment on it. The positions of this code within $T$ are exactly $S$.
hypotheses_covered: The width of $T$ is at most $w$
$S$ is a finite set of literal-list positions
A bit in $\mathbb F_2$ is assigned to each element of the mapped position set
